q.t: Find 15% of 200.
Write 3/8 as a percentage.
Write 120% as a fraction in lowest terms.
q.e: 120/100 = 6/5. More than 100% means more than one whole.

q.t: What percent of 80 is 20?
Write 0.6% as a decimal.
40% of a number is 16. Find the number.
Increase 50 by 10%.
q.e: 10% of 50 is 5, so the new value is 55.

q.t: Write 2.5 as a percentage.
Write 1/3 as a percentage.
How many minutes are 75% of an hour?
A number increased by 20% becomes 144. Find the number.
A number decreased by 15% becomes 340. Find the number.
A student scores 325 out of 500. Find the percentage.
Write 8 1/3% as a fraction.
x is 25% more than 80. Find x.
A machine worth ₹80,000 loses 10% of its value in a year. Find its value after one year (in ₹).
In an exam 60% of the candidates pass and 280 fail. How many candidates were there?
A price rises from ₹450 to ₹495. Find the percentage increase.
Write the ratio 3 : 5 as a percentage.
A town of 50,000 people grows by 4% in the first year and 5% in the second. Find the population after two years.
q.e: After year 1: 52,000. Year 2 adds 5% of 52,000 = 2,600 → 54,600. The second rise is on the new figure.

q.t: A’s salary is 20% less than B’s. By what percent is B’s salary more than A’s?
q.e: Let B = 100, A = 80. B is 20 more than A, measured on A: 20/80 = 25%.

q.t: Find 5% of 10% of 2000.
In a two-candidate election the winner gets 62% of the votes and wins by 7200 votes. How many votes did the winner get?
q.e: The loser has 38%, so the gap is 24% = 7200 and the total is 30,000. Winner: 62% of 30,000 = 18,600.

q.t: A price is cut by 20%. By what percent must the new price be raised to get back to the original?
q.e: 100 → 80. To climb back 20 from 80 needs 20/80 = 25%, because the base is now smaller.

q.t: When 75 is added to 75% of a number, the result is the number. Find the number.
Gunpowder is 75% nitre, 10% sulphur and the rest charcoal. How much charcoal is in 9 kg of gunpowder (in kg)?
A is 20% of B, and B is 50% of C. A is what percent of C?
The length of a rectangle is increased by 20% and its breadth decreased by 10%. Find the percentage increase in area.
q.e: New area = 1.2 × 0.9 = 1.08 times the old: an 8% increase.

q.t: A student needs 35% to pass. He gets 150 marks and fails by 25 marks. Find the maximum marks.
q.e: Pass mark = 175 = 35% of the maximum, so maximum = 175 ÷ 0.35 = 500.

q.t: A town’s population grew by 10% every year for 3 years and is now 26,620. What was it 3 years ago?
q.e: Each year multiplies by 1.1, so three years multiply by 1.331. 26,620 ÷ 1.331 = 20,000.

q.t: In an election 10% of the voters on the list did not vote and 60 votes were invalid. The winner got 47% of ALL the voters on the list and won by 308 votes. How many voters were on the list?
q.e: Valid votes = 0.9T − 60. Winner 0.47T, loser 0.43T − 60. Gap = 0.04T + 60 = 308, so T = 6200.

q.t: A salary is raised by 10% and then cut by 5%, and is now ₹20,900. Find the original salary (in ₹).
A 20% cut in the price of sugar lets a family buy 5 kg more for ₹600. Find the reduced price per kg (in ₹).
q.e: The saving is 20% of ₹600 = ₹120, and that ₹120 buys the extra 5 kg at the new price: 120 ÷ 5 = 24.

q.t: Fresh fruit is 68% water and dried fruit is 20% water. How much dried fruit comes from 100 kg of fresh fruit (in kg)?
q.e: The solid part (32 kg) does not change. In dried fruit it is 80% of the weight: 32 ÷ 0.8 = 40 kg.

q.t: A’s income is 10% more than B’s, and B’s is 20% more than C’s. C earns ₹5000. Find A’s income (in ₹).
30% of A equals 25% of B. A is what percent of B?
Two numbers are 20% and 50% more than a third number. The first is what percent of the second?
q.e: Let the third be 100: the others are 120 and 150. 120/150 = 80%.

q.t: A man spends 75% of his income. His income rises by 20% and his spending by 10%. By what percent do his savings increase?
A class of 60 students is 40% girls. How many more girls must join for girls to be 50% of the class?
q.e: There are 24 girls and 36 boys. Girls are half when they equal the boys: 36 − 24 = 12 more.
